Direct shear test on LSM soil (Mixture of RC and Air-Floated Clay) at relative density 0.50; apparatus: 2-1/2-inch diameter shear box; loading: constant normal stress; lateral shear. Recorded: angle of internal friction.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: specimen height, normal stress, held constant are not reported.
:::
